messages.subject: Stochastic Compartmental model
parts:
Hi
I am trying to use NIMBLE for a stochastic compartmental model but I get following warning for all the nodes:
"slice sampler reached maximum number of contractions for ..."
and then the system stops working.
I appreciate it if you can guide me on how I can solve it.
Thanks in advance.
Neda

messages.author: c9e9cbbfb3b043f0
messages.subject: Re: Stochastic Compartmental model
parts:
Neda, thanks for your interest in using nimble.  My guess is this comes down to proper initialization of your model.  As a first step, you might try:

## assuming "model" is a nimble model object, created using nimbleModel(...)
model$initializeInfo()   ## read the output message
model$calculate()        ## see if this returns a real number

These might help you find what node(s) in the model are not properly initialized, assuming that's the problem.  Providing valid initial values for all stochastic nodes in your model might solve the sampling problem.

Beyond this, it's hard to diagnose what's happening without a reproducible example.

Good luck!
Daniel
